verdict.rationale: Muse is explicitly designed as a chat-first agent: 'just tell Muse what you want to get done,' with no learning curve, and users interact via natural language in chat, WhatsApp, or a Goals tab rather than structured commands. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence confirming natural-language commands reliably produce correct agent actions at scale (the HN stress-test report focuses on control-plane timeouts under load, not NL comprehension itself).
